fields.mechanism: Methane production by intestinal methanogen overgrowth (IMO) via methane‑producing archaea (Methanobrevibacter smithii).
fields.intervention: Embed a sealed, syrup‑compatible micro‑bioreactor that contains a slow‑release substrate for methanogenic archaea (or a chemical analog) which, upon warming, generates methane gas; the gas pressure passively forces syrup through the check valve to re‑prime it.
fields.expected_effect: Generated methane pressure clears air pockets and pushes syrup past the valve, maintaining prime after warm restarts without any electronic control.
